pairs.question: Quid signi?
pairs.answer: Nulli sumptus, nulla iactura, nulla versura.
pairs.derivation: Self-posed question and immediate declarative answer. Cicero, having said Caelius would reply he strayed from the path under no desire ("Huic tristi ac derecto seni responderet Caelius se nulla cupiditate inductum de via decessisse"), asks what the proof is and answers it himself by enumerating the absent signs of dissipation. The narrative setup sentence is left out as framing/indirect speech; the question is the bare interrogative "Quid signi?" and the answer is the contiguous declarative "Nulli sumptus, nulla iactura, nulla versura." The next sentence "At fuit fama." turns to a new objection, so the answer stops at the first full stop.
